name: @tn4consulting/shared-federation-runtime
description: RemoteRouteHost (now with optional prop-forwarding for host route state), RemoteModuleLoaderContext, and the generic WidgetRegistryContext/useWidgetLoader keyed-widget-loader mechanism -- the shared React Context patterns for safely loading federated modules. 2.0.0 replaces the 1.x one-Context-per-widget-type pattern (PaymentHistoryWidgetLoaderContext, JobApplicationsWidgetLoaderContext, EiReportingStatusWidgetLoaderContext) with a single registry keyed by widget id, added to support the mfe-pot family's multi-life-event architecture (see mfe-pot/docs/plans/). The last 0.x (Angular DI-token-shaped) major stays published only as a historical artifact.
